comment: Microsoft Sentinel Analytics Rule — AKS Pod Exec Detection. Deploy via: az deployment group create --template-file pod-exec-analytics-rule.json --resource-group <rg>

metadata.description: Name of the Log Analytics Workspace linked to Microsoft Sentinel
Set to false to deploy in disabled state for initial tuning

properties.description: Detects unauthorized kubectl exec or direct API exec calls into Kubernetes pods. An exec session into a running pod is a strong indicator of post-compromise activity. Maps to MITRE ATT&CK T1609 (Container Administration Command) and T1611 (Escape to Host).
properties.query:
// See: sentinel/kql/aks_pod_exec_detection.kql
// Paste full KQL query content here for production deployment
AKSAudit
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(5m)
| where Stage =~ "ResponseComplete"
| where ObjectRef_Resource =~ "pods"
    and ObjectRef_Subresource =~ "exec"
    and Verb =~ "create"
| where User_Username !startswith "system:node:"
    and User_Username !startswith "system:serviceaccount:kube-system:"
| extend IsKubectl = UserAgent contains "kubectl"
| extend IsAnonymous = User_Username =~ "system:anonymous" or isempty(User_Username)
| extend ExecSucceeded = ResponseStatus_Code in (101, 200)
| extend RiskScore = case(
    IsAnonymous and ExecSucceeded, 100,
    IsKubectl and ExecSucceeded, 75,
    IsAnonymous, 85,
    IsKubectl, 50,
    45)
| where RiskScore >= 45 or IsAnonymous
| extend AlertSeverity = case(RiskScore >= 90, "Critical", RiskScore >= 70, "High", "Medium")
| project TimeGenerated, ActorUsername=User_Username, UserAgent,
    SourceIPs=tostring(SourceIps), TargetPod=ObjectRef_Name,
    TargetNamespace=ObjectRef_Namespace, ResponseCode=ResponseStatus_Code,
    ExecSucceeded, RiskScore, AlertSeverity,
    ClusterResourceId=ResourceId, AuditEventId=AuditID,
    MitreTechnique="T1609 - Container Administration Command"
| order by RiskScore desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Unauthorized exec into pod {{TargetPod}} in namespace {{TargetNamespace}} by {{ActorUsername}} from {{SourceIPs}}. Exec succeeded: {{ExecSucceeded}}. Risk score: {{RiskScore}}/100. MITRE: {{MitreTechnique}}
